name: NeoLite Review Customizer for WooCommerce
author: Pamir

sections.description:
NeoLite Review Customizer is a lightweight, zero-bloat plugin that helps you customize the appearance and behavior of your WooCommerce review section to better match your brand, build customer trust, and encourage more product reviews.

Whether you want to personalize the Reviews tab, modernize the review experience, or protect customer privacy, NeoLite Review Customizer makes it simple with an intuitive settings page.

Why Choose NeoLite Review Customizer?

Product reviews are one of the most influential factors in a customer’s buying decision. A well-designed review section builds credibility, increases engagement, and can improve conversion rates.

Instead of relying on WooCommerce’s default review interface, customize it to reflect your brand and create a more engaging shopping experience.

Features

Customize Review Star Color

Replace WooCommerce’s default yellow rating stars with a color that matches your brand for a consistent, professional look.

Rename the Reviews Tab

Change the default “Reviews” tab to a custom label such as Customer Reviews, Testimonials, Wall of Love, or any title that fits your store.

Customize the Empty Review Call-to-Action

Replace the default “Be the first to review {Product Name}” form heading with your own custom call-to-action when a product has no reviews yet. Supports {product_name} placeholder.

Examples:
* Be the first to review {product_name}!
* Share your experience and help other shoppers.
* Write the first review and earn loyalty points!

Hide Review Dates

Optionally remove review dates to keep your review section looking clean and timeless.

Protect Customer Privacy

Display reviewer names in a privacy-friendly format by showing only the first name and last initial (for example, John D.) instead of the full name.

NeoGrow Loyalty Integration

Works seamlessly with NeoGrow to reward customers with loyalty points when they submit product reviews, encouraging engagement and repeat purchases.

Lightweight by Design

NeoLite Review Customizer is built with performance in mind.
* No unnecessary features
* No database bloat
* Clean, native WooCommerce integration
* Beginner-friendly settings
* Compatible with modern WooCommerce versions

Install it, configure it in minutes, and give your WooCommerce review section a polished, branded appearance.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the neolite-review-customizer folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your settings under NeoPlugin > Review Customizer.
sections.faq:
Does NeoLite Review Customizer require WooCommerce?

Yes. NeoLite Review Customizer is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Does NeoLite Review Customizer require NeoGrow?

No. NeoLite Review Customizer works as a standalone WooCommerce plugin. If you also use NeoGrow, the two plugins complement each other by combining review customization with loyalty rewards for customer reviews.

What can I customize in WooCommerce product reviews?

NeoLite Review Customizer currently lets you change the review star color, rename the Reviews tab, customize the “There are no reviews yet” message, hide review dates, and display reviewer names in a privacy-friendly format.

Can I change the WooCommerce Reviews tab title?

Yes. You can replace the default “Reviews” tab with any custom label, such as “Customer Reviews,” “Testimonials,” “Wall of Love,” or any title that better matches your brand.

Can I change the color of WooCommerce review stars?

Yes. NeoLite Review Customizer allows you to replace WooCommerce’s default review star color with a custom color that matches your store’s branding.

Can I replace the “There are no reviews yet” message?

Yes. You can display your own custom message to encourage customers to write the first product review or promote incentives such as loyalty rewards.

Can I hide WooCommerce review dates?

Yes. You can hide review dates with a single setting if you prefer a cleaner, evergreen appearance for your product reviews.

Can I hide customers’ full names in reviews?

Yes. NeoLite Review Customizer can display reviewer names using the first name and last initial (for example, “John D.”) to help protect customer privacy.

Does NeoLite Review Customizer slow down WooCommerce?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only customizes WooCommerce’s existing review interface. It does not add unnecessary database tables or background processes.

Does NeoLite Review Customizer work with my WooCommerce theme?

In most cases, yes. The plugin uses WooCommerce’s standard hooks and filters, making it compatible with most well-coded WooCommerce themes.

Is NeoLite Review Customizer compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Since the plugin customizes product reviews rather than order storage, it is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Will NeoLite Review Customizer modify my existing reviews?

No. Your existing product reviews remain unchanged. The plugin only customizes how reviews are displayed on your WooCommerce store.

Can customers earn loyalty points for writing reviews?

Yes, when NeoGrow is also installed. NeoLite Review Customizer enhances the review experience, while NeoGrow can reward customers with loyalty points for eligible product reviews.

Is NeoLite Review Customizer translation-ready?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress internationalization standards and is ready to be translated into other languages.

Are more features planned?

Yes. Future releases are planned to include additional review customization options, layouts, filters, and other enhancements based on user feedback.
